# fromDefinition

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Builds a document from a definition. Validates first, and throws a [`DefinitionError`](definition-error.md) listing every problem if there are any; nothing is constructed from an invalid definition.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core/definition`.

```typescript
fromDefinition(input: unknown, options?: DefinitionReadOptions): Promise<Document>
```
